title: Big Travel Plans
setting: A bright living room with a large world map on the wall.

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt)

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt)

sentences.en: Sara and Kofi look at a big world map.
sentences.zh: 萨拉和科菲看着一张大大的世界地图。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) and Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) stand in front of a large world map with no writing on the living room wall.
sentences.narration: Sara and Kofi stand in front of a large world map with no writing on the living room wall.

sentences.en: Sara wants to visit Germany in Europe.
sentences.zh: 萨拉想去欧洲的德国游玩。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) points at Germany in Europe on the world map, smiling.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Sara pointing at Germany on the map; 'wants to visit' can't be shown.
sentences.narration: Sara points at Germany in Europe on the world map, smiling.

sentence_targets.en: the continent west of Asia and north of Africa
To go to see a person or place.

sentences.en: Kofi shakes his head: Australia is very far.
sentences.zh: 科菲摇摇头：澳大利亚太远了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) shakes his head and points at Australia at the bottom of the map.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Kofi shaking his head at Australia on the map; 'very far' is only hinted.
sentences.narration: Kofi shakes his head and points at Australia at the bottom of the map.

sentence_targets.en: the body part containing the brain, eyes, and mouth
At, to, or over a great distance.
a country occupying a continent between the Indian and Pacific Oceans

sentences.en: Mexico is to the south of America.
sentences.scene_prompt: The finger of Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) moves down the map from the United States to Mexico.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a finger moving down the map; country names can't be read.
sentences.narration: The finger of Kofi moves down the map from the United States to Mexico.

sentence_targets.en: A country in North America, south of the United States.

sentences.en: Sara moves her finger from Canada to Asia.
sentences.zh: 萨拉的手指从加拿大移到亚洲。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) moves her finger across the world map from Canada to Asia.
sentences.narration: Sara moves her finger across the world map from Canada to Asia.

sentence_targets.en: The world's largest continent, lying mainly east of Europe.
a country in North America, north of the United States

sentences.en: In Germany, trains leave from a big station.
sentences.zh: 在德国，火车从一个大车站出发。
sentences.scene_prompt: A fast train leaves a big busy station with a glass roof, a small German flag hanging on a pillar.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a train leaving a big station; that it is in Germany is only hinted by the flag.
sentences.narration: A fast train leaves a big busy station with a glass roof, a small German flag hanging on a pillar.

sentence_targets.en: A place where trains or buses stop for passengers.
Connected railway vehicles that carry passengers or goods.

sentences.en: Kofi puts his bicycle in a big box.
sentences.zh: 科菲把他的自行车放进一个大箱子里。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) puts his bicycle into a big cardboard box in the living room, Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) holding the box open.
sentences.narration: Kofi puts his bicycle into a big cardboard box in the living room, Sara holding the box open.

sentence_targets.en: a two-wheeled vehicle moved by pushing pedals

sentences.en: Then they drive their car to the airport.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) and Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) drive their car along a road toward an airport, a plane in the sky above.
sentences.narration: Sara and Kofi drive their car along a road toward an airport, a plane in the sky above.

sentence_targets.en: A place where planes take off, land, and collect passengers
a road vehicle with wheels, usually carrying a few people
